races.name: Al Basti Equiworld, Dubai Apprentice Handicap (Racing Excellence - Whips To Be Carried But Not Used)

runners_data.name: Allegrino
runners_data.note: Natural front-runner with clear tactical advantage and solid 7f form, returning after 129 days but Balding yard in good form

runners_data.name: Orange Emperor
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse with handicap mark that's won over C&D previously, but faces tactical disadvantage with 5lb claimer aboard

runners_data.name: Ahead Of Fashion
runners_data.note: Another hold-up horse with decent recent form at 7f, trained by yard with excellent recent strike-rate but needs pace to aim at

runners_data.name: Red Moon
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse with concerning form figures and tendency to fade in finish, making tactical scenario even harder

runners_data.name: Creciente
runners_data.note: Lowest-rated hold-up horse carrying headgear, bottom weight but poor recent form and wrong running style for race shape

races.paceDynamic: Allegrino sits as the only natural pace-setter with a prominent style, facing four hold-up horses in this small field. With no pace pressure, Allegrino can dictate terms and set a controlled gallop over 7f at Salisbury. Orange Emperor, Ahead Of Fashion, Red Moon and Creciente must all come from behind, creating a tactical nightmare where they'll need the pace-setter to stop. This race shape strongly favours the front-runner and any horse that can track close early, penalising pure hold-up merchants who rely on strong pace.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Allegrino Controls Uncontested
scenarios.trigger: If Allegrino gets an easy lead without early pressure from the hold-up horses
scenarios.body: The pace-setter can dictate fractions and kick when ready, while the quartet of hold-up horses face an impossible task trying to reel in a fresh front-runner. Allegrino's recent form shows comfort at 7f and the tactical advantage proves decisive.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horse Forces Pace
scenarios.trigger: If one of the hold-up horses forces the issue early to prevent Allegrino getting an easy time
scenarios.body: Orange Emperor or Ahead Of Fashion may press forward to ensure a true gallop, creating the pace scenario the hold-up horses need. This tactical sacrifice allows the other closers to benefit from genuine pace.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Slow Pace Kick
scenarios.trigger: If Allegrino sets pedestrian fractions and the field bunches for a sprint finish
scenarios.body: The race becomes a 2f dash where class tells and recent form matters most, with Orange Emperor's hold-up style potentially effective in a bunched finish. Fresh legs and tactical positioning become crucial in the final furlong.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Complete Pace Collapse
scenarios.trigger: If Allegrino sets such slow fractions that even the hold-up horses struggle to generate momentum
scenarios.body: The race turns into a crawl where nobody wants to make the running, creating a messy affair that suits the least worst option. Form and fitness become secondary to whoever can manufacture late momentum.

watchPoints.text: Watch if any hold-up horse tries to press Allegrino early as this completely changes the race dynamic and pace scenario
Monitor Orange Emperor's positioning turning for home as his class could overcome tactical disadvantage if race develops into sprint
Observe Allegrino's jumping from the gates as any slow start allows hold-up horses to force stronger pace
Watch for Ahead Of Fashion tracking closer than usual given trainer's excellent recent form and need for tactical adjustment
Check Red Moon's finishing effort as recent form suggests stamina concerns that tactical disadvantage will expose further

races.name: Peter Lawrence Memorial Handicap

runners_data.name: Kisskodi
runners_data.note: Front-runner with good recent soft ground form, likely to get an easy lead but may lack finishing kick

runners_data.name: Diamondonthehill
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse with highest rating, needs strong pace to show his class from the back

runners_data.name: The Dragon King
runners_data.note: Prominent runner ideally positioned to track the leader, Clive Cox runners often improve for break

runners_data.name: It'sneverjustone
runners_data.note: Another prominent type who handles soft ground well, 57 days off not ideal but going suits

runners_data.name: Blue Prince
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse who ran well on soft ground last time, only 7 days between runs

runners_data.name: Ararat
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse stepping up in trip, lowest rated but Ryan Kavanagh's 5lb claim helps

runners_data.name: Land Of Magic
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse coming off a soft ground win, headgear change to tongue tie may help

runners_data.name: Spirit Of Breeze
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse returning from 222-day absence, serious fitness concerns despite past soft ground form

races.paceDynamic: Kisskodi will take up the early lead with The Dragon King and It'sneverjustone likely to race prominently, creating a moderate pace rather than breakneck speed. The five hold-up horses (Diamondonthehill, Blue Prince, Ararat, Land Of Magic, Spirit Of Breeze) will settle behind this front trio. With soft ground conditions and 7f at Salisbury providing a decent test of stamina, the pace should be honest but not destructive. This race shape clearly favours the prominent racers who can sit close to Kisskodi without having to come from too far back on testing ground.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Prominent Trackers Dominate
scenarios.trigger: If the pace remains honest but not too strong early
scenarios.body: The front three can sustain their position while the hold-up brigade struggle to make ground on soft turf. The Dragon King and It'sneverjustone are perfectly placed to pounce when Kisskodi tires.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Kisskodi Wire-to-Wire
scenarios.trigger: If no horse seriously challenges the leader until too late
scenarios.body: Kisskodi gets an easy lead and kicks clear in the straight before the closers can respond. George Wood times the move perfectly on ground that suits.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Late Surge Success
scenarios.trigger: If the pace becomes genuinely strong early with pressure on Kisskodi
scenarios.body: The front-runners tie up badly in the soft conditions, allowing the classiest hold-up horse to sweep past. Diamondonthehill's superior rating tells late.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Outsider Ambush
scenarios.trigger: If the race fragments with uneven pace or traffic problems
scenarios.body: One of the longer-priced hold-up horses finds a dream passage through to cause an upset. The soft ground levels the playing field for the lower-rated runners.

watchPoints.text: Spirit Of Breeze market support given the massive 222-day layoff and hold-up style on testing ground
Kisskodi's early fractions - if allowed to dawdle he becomes much more dangerous late
The Dragon King's position turning in - needs to be within two lengths to use his finishing kick
Diamondonthehill's passage in running - any traffic problems from the back will end his chances
It'sneverjustone's jumping from the stalls after the long break - early position crucial for prominent runner

races.name: R Hannon Racing Supports The Savitri Waney Charity EBF Novice Stakes (GBB/IRE Incentive Race)
H S Lester Memorial Challenge Cup 'Confined' Handicap (No Win Since 2025 Flat Turf Season)

runners_data.name: Primo Lara
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse facing significant traffic concerns with seven others sharing similar tactics and 11 days since last run.

runners_data.name: Criminal
runners_data.note: Needs Ryan to break from usual hold-up pattern to avoid inevitable congestion with quick 4-day turnaround.

runners_data.name: Somkiyr
runners_data.note: Hold-up style puts him at major tactical disadvantage in this field composition with inexperienced trainer.

runners_data.name: Redbud Sixteen
runners_data.note: Another hold-up merchant returning from 69-day layoff into a race that doesn't suit his running style.

runners_data.name: Suhub
runners_data.note: Only confirmed front-runner gets dream scenario with 5-pound claimer taking valuable weight off.

runners_data.name: Huggable
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse must overcome 26-day break and navigate traffic with superior jockey Billy Loughnane aboard.

runners_data.name: King's Castle
runners_data.note: Veteran's prominent style and stamina gives him tactical edge over the hold-up brigade despite 9-year-old age.

runners_data.name: Mighty Quiet
runners_data.note: Recent winner but hold-up style creates problems, though headgear change and Charlton stable form offer hope.

runners_data.name: Castle Quarter
runners_data.note: Massive outsider returning from 1720-day layoff with 7-pound claimer, purely for place money at best.

races.paceDynamic: Suhub will set the tempo from the front with King's Castle likely to track closely in second, creating a sustainable but not pressured gallop in the early stages. The bulk of the field - Criminal, Primo Lara, Redbud Sixteen, Huggable, Mighty Quiet, Sixfiveseven and Castle Quarter - are all hold-up merchants who will settle towards the rear. With only one confirmed front-runner and minimal early pressure, Suhub can dictate fractions and potentially steal a march on the closing brigade. This pace dynamic strongly favours front-runners and prominent racers who can avoid the inevitable traffic problems behind.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Front Runner Steals March
scenarios.trigger: If Suhub gets an uncontested lead and kicks clear turning for home
scenarios.body: The lack of early pace allows the front-runner to build an unassailable advantage while the hold-up horses get caught in traffic. Mason Paetel can time his move perfectly without pressure from behind.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Traffic Carnage
scenarios.trigger: If the massive hold-up contingent gets bunched up and can't find clear runs
scenarios.body: Seven horses trying to make late moves creates a bottleneck that only the best-positioned closers can navigate. The superior jockeys like Hornby and Loughnane find the gaps while others are trapped.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: King's Castle Pounces Late
scenarios.trigger: If the veteran tracks Suhub perfectly and outstays him in the final furlong
scenarios.body: David Simcock's nine-year-old uses his experience to sit second, let Suhub do the donkey work, then exploit his superior stamina over this extended trip. The hold-up horses arrive too late after giving away too much start.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Surprise Hold-Up Success
scenarios.trigger: If Rossa Ryan gets Criminal into an ideal stalking position and avoids the traffic
scenarios.body: The Richard Hughes-trained four-year-old breaks the mould by racing more prominently than usual and gets first run on the field. His class advantage tells when getting a clear passage.

watchPoints.text: Suhub getting an uncontested early lead could prove decisive with only King's Castle for company in the first half-mile.
Traffic problems at the two-furlong pole when seven hold-up horses all converge simultaneously looking for racing room.
King's Castle's positioning behind Suhub - if Taryn Langley gets it wrong the 9-year-old could be caught flat-footed.
Criminal's early positioning - Ryan needs to break the mould and race more prominently than the horse's usual hold-up style.
Mason Paetel's 5-pound claim on Suhub in front-running role could be the difference between winning and getting caught.

runners_data.name: Kamaway

runners_data.name: Dark Rosa

runners_data.name: Thiscouldbefun

runners_data.name: Spirit Of The Bay

runners_data.name: Opening Bat
runners_data.note: Hold-up style who showed some form earlier but will struggle to get a clear run in this competitive field

runners_data.name: Spirit Lead Me
runners_data.note: Hold-up runner with a concerning pattern of fading in the finish, making traffic problems even more damaging

runners_data.name: Rating
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse with 5lb claimer who has shown recent improvement but faces positioning nightmare with similar types

runners_data.name: Eutropia
runners_data.note: Should sit second behind Kamaway and benefit from avoiding the traffic chaos that will engulf the hold-up horses

runners_data.name: Lunanova

races.paceDynamic: Kamaway is the only confirmed front runner and should get an uncontested lead, setting a sustainable pace with Eutropia likely to sit just behind in second. With 11 hold-up horses in the field, there will be a wall of traffic problems in the straight as they all try to find racing room simultaneously. The lack of early pace means the leaders will have plenty left for the finish, while the hold-up brigade will face a nightmare scenario trying to weave through traffic on the Good to Soft ground. This race shape strongly favours the early pace-setters and any horse that can secure a prominent position turning for home.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Uncontested Front Runner Wins
scenarios.trigger: If Kamaway gets an easy lead and maintains rhythm
scenarios.body: The prominent runners control the race from the front while the hold-up horses get caught in traffic behind a wall of 11 closers. Kamaway or Eutropia capitalize on their positional advantage when the field bunches up in the straight.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Traffic Nightmare Chaos
scenarios.trigger: If the hold-up horses all hit traffic simultaneously
scenarios.body: The 11 hold-up horses create a bottleneck turning for home as they seek the same gaps. Only the luckiest hold-up horse with the clearest passage can emerge from the chaos to challenge the leaders.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Strong Finisher Finds Gap
scenarios.trigger: If one hold-up horse gets a clean run through
scenarios.body: A well-positioned hold-up horse with tactical speed avoids the traffic and produces a late surge. The soft ground helps stamina types who can stay on strongly when others tire.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Complete Pace Collapse
scenarios.trigger: If Kamaway stops suddenly in front
scenarios.body: The uncontested leader hits the wall leaving a vacuum up front with no other natural pace. The field comes together in a messy finish where any horse can win from the chaos.

watchPoints.text: Kamaway must be watched for any signs of stopping in front as he is the only pace-setter in the field
The bend turning for home will create a bottleneck as 11 hold-up horses simultaneously look for the same gaps
Eutropia's position behind Kamaway is crucial as she represents the main threat to the leader if positioned well
Any hold-up horse that secures an early prominent position will have a significant tactical advantage over the field
The 5lb and 7lb claiming jockeys on Rating, Thiscouldbefun, Lunanova and Norflondonforever may struggle with tactical positioning in such a complex pace scenario

runners_data.name: Tryfan
runners_data.note: Natural hold-up horse faces tactical disadvantage with limited early pace to target

runners_data.name: Arcturus Flame
runners_data.note: Prominent style suits the likely modest tempo with good recent form at this trip

runners_data.name: Twilight Moon
runners_data.note: Confirmed pace-setter with recent winning form, perfectly positioned tactically

runners_data.name: Just An Hour
runners_data.note: Prominent runner with solid course form who can track the leader and challenge late

runners_data.name: Johnny Boom
runners_data.note: Hold-up style needs stronger pace but carries dangerous low weight as former winner

runners_data.name: Fair Dinkum
runners_data.note: Recent winner but hold-up style faces same tactical concerns as other closers

runners_data.name: Taritino
runners_data.note: Prominent runner returning quickly from recent run with capable pilot

races.paceDynamic: Twilight Moon will likely lead from the start with minimal early pressure, as most runners prefer prominent or hold-up positions. Arcturus Flame, Just An Hour and Taritino may track close but won't challenge the early tempo. The modest pace will allow Twilight Moon to dictate throughout the middle stages before the field closes late. This sustainable tempo heavily favours prominent runners who can position handy and kick, while hold-up horses face a tactical disadvantage with limited pace to aim at.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Modest Pace Throughout
scenarios.trigger: If Twilight Moon leads unchallenged and sets a comfortable tempo
scenarios.body: The steady gallop allows prominent runners to stay close without stress before launching late challenges. Hold-up horses struggle to make ground with insufficient pace collapse.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Early Pace Duel
scenarios.trigger: If Arcturus Flame or Just An Hour press Twilight Moon early
scenarios.body: The increased tempo opens up the race for closers while potentially setting up the leaders for late vulnerability. Hold-up horses benefit from stronger gallop.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Wire-to-Wire Leader
scenarios.trigger: If Twilight Moon maintains control and kicks clear turning in
scenarios.body: The leader's recent winning form and tactical advantage prove decisive against a modest field. Late closers left with too much to do.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Late Surge Scenario
scenarios.trigger: If the pace collapses dramatically in the final two furlongs
scenarios.body: Extreme pace collapse allows natural hold-up horses to showcase their closing kick. Front runners tie up badly.

watchPoints.text: Twilight Moon getting loose on the lead - if unchallenged early, could prove very difficult to peg back
Johnny Boom and Fair Dinkum struggling to get competitive positions - hold-up horses need luck in running
Just An Hour and Arcturus Flame positioning behind leader - their placement will determine scenario outcome
Pace development after first half-mile - any early pressure changes the entire complexion
Taritino's quick turnaround after recent run - fitness levels compared to fresher rivals
